cards.ex: We spent the afternoon just shooting the breeze about everything and nothing.
cards.exUz: Biz butun tushdan keyinni hamma narsa va hech narsa haqida behuda gaplashib o'tkazdik.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadsiz, oddiy mavzularda suhbatlashish; vaqt o'tkazish uchun gaplashish.

cards.ex: A little bird told me it's your birthday next week!
cards.exUz: Eshitishimcha, keyingi hafta tug'ilgan kuningiz ekan!
cards.uzDef: Kimdandir sirli ravishda xabar oldim, lekin manbani aytmayman.

cards.ex: Let's touch base next week to discuss the project further.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi hafta loyihani yanada muhokama qilish uchun aloqada bo'laylik.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa vaqt ichida bog'lanib, xabar almashish.

cards.ex: Keep me posted on your job search; I'm really rooting for you.
cards.exUz: Meni ish qidiruvingizdan xabardor qilib turing; sizga chin dildan omad tilayman.
cards.uzDef: Meni voqealardan xabardor qilib turing, yangiliklarni ayting.

cards.ex: Before we move forward, let's make sure we're all on the same page.
cards.exUz: Oldinga siljishdan oldin, hammamiz bir xil fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, bir xil tushunchaga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: You can't make it? Fair enough, maybe next time.
cards.exUz: Qatnasha olmaysizmi? Adolatli, balki keyingi safar.
cards.uzDef: Qaror yoki fikr oqilona ekanligiga rozilik bildirish.

cards.ex: Give me a shout when you're free, and we'll grab coffee.
cards.exUz: Bo'sh vaqtingiz bo'lganda menga xabar bering, va biz qahva ichamiz.
cards.uzDef: Menga xabar bering, qo'ng'iroq qiling.

cards.ex: How's that report coming? Is it almost finished?
cards.exUz: Hisobot qanday ketyapti? Deyarli tugallandingizmi?
cards.uzDef: Ishning yoki vazifaning bajarilish jarayoni haqida so'rash.

cards.ex: By the way, did you hear about Sarah's promotion?
cards.exUz: Aytgancha, Sarohning lavozimi ko'tarilganini eshitdingizmi?
cards.uzDef: Yangi mavzuni kiritish uchun ishlatiladigan ibora.

cards.ex: Hey Mark! What brings you here to this part of town?
cards.exUz: Salom, Mark! Shaharning bu qismiga nima sababdan keldingiz?
cards.uzDef: Bu yerga kelishingizning sababi nima?

cards.ex: Hey, John! Anything new with you since we last spoke?
cards.exUz: Salom, Jon! Oxirgi marta gaplashganimizdan beri yangi narsa bormi?
cards.uzDef: Hayotingizda yangi voqealar yoki o'zgarishlar bormi?

cards.ex: Have you lived around here long?
cards.exUz: Bu yerlarda uzoq vaqtdan beri yashayapsizmi?
cards.uzDef: Bu hududda, shu atrofda.

cards.ex: I've been out and about all day, running errands.
cards.exUz: Men butun kun ko'chada, turli ishlarni bajarib yurdim.
cards.uzDef: Uyda emas, tashqarida, ko'chada yurish.

cards.ex: It's hard to get a word in when he's talking; he dominates the conversation.
cards.exUz: U gapirayotganda gapga qo'shilish qiyin; u suhbatda hukmronlik qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Suhbatga aralashish, o'z fikrini bildirish imkoniyatiga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: Are you by any chance related to the Smith family?
cards.exUz: Siz tasodifan Smit oilasiga aloqadormisiz?
cards.uzDef: Ehtimolmi, balki tasodifan shunday bo'lgandir?

cards.ex: They're thinking of moving to London. What do you reckon?
cards.exUz: Ular Londonga ko'chib o'tishni o'ylashmoqda. Nima deb o'ylaysiz?
cards.uzDef: Sizning fikringiz qanday? Nima deb hisoblaysiz?

cards.ex: Thanks for the chat! Hear from you soon.
cards.exUz: Suhbat uchun rahmat! Tez orada sizdan xabar olaman.
cards.uzDef: Sizdan tez orada xabar olishga umid qilaman.

cards.ex: You seem distracted. What's on your mind?
cards.exUz: Siz chalg'igan ko'rinasiz. Nima o'ylayapsan?
cards.uzDef: Sizni nima tashvishlantiryapti? Nima haqida o'ylayapsiz?

cards.ex: "I'm on a seafood diet. I see food and I eat it." - That's a good one!
cards.exUz: "Men dengiz mahsulotlari dietasidaman. Men ovqatni ko'raman va yeyman." - Bu zo'r gap!
cards.uzDef: Bu yaxshi hazil yoki fikr ekanligini bildirish.

cards.ex: Hey, how's business treating you these days?
cards.exUz: Salom, biznesingiz sizga qanday ta'sir qilyapti?
cards.uzDef: Biznes yoki kasbingiz qanday ketyapti?

cards.ex: If you get the chance, visit the new art gallery downtown.
cards.exUz: Agar imkoniyat bo'lsa, shahar markazidagi yangi san'at galereyasiga tashrif buyuring.
cards.uzDef: Agar imkoniyat bo'lsa, fursatdan foydalaning.

cards.ex: What I mean is, the project needs more resources.
cards.exUz: Demoqchimanki, loyihaga ko'proq resurslar kerak.
cards.uzDef: Fikringizni aniqlashtirish yoki qayta ta'kidlash uchun ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: I've been meaning to call you, but I've been so busy.
cards.exUz: Sizga qo'ng'iroq qilish niyatim bor edi, lekin juda band edim.
cards.uzDef: Qilmoqchi bo'lgan ishni kechiktirganingizni aytish.

cards.ex: Opera? It's not really my cup of tea, to be honest.
cards.exUz: Opera? Rostini aytsam, bu unchalik menga mos emas.
cards.term: It's not my cup of tea
cards.uzDef: Bu narsa menga yoqmaydi, qiziq emas.

cards.ex: I'll try to find the time to help you move this weekend.
cards.exUz: Men bu hafta oxiri ko'chishingizga yordam berish uchun vaqt topishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Qilish uchun vaqt topishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I've gotta run, catch you later!
cards.exUz: Men ketishim kerak, keyin ko'rishguncha!
cards.uzDef: Tez orada ko'rishishga umid qilib, xayrlashish iborasi.

cards.ex: How do you like your new job?
cards.exUz: Yangi ishingiz qanday yoqdi?
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida fikringizni so'rash.

cards.ex: I ran into an old friend at the grocery store yesterday.
cards.exUz: Kecha oziq-ovqat do'konida eski do'stimni uchratib qoldim.
cards.uzDef: Tasodifan kimnidir uchratib qolish.

cards.ex: So, anyway, I was telling you about my trip to Italy...
cards.exUz: Xullas, shunday qilib, men sizga Italiyaga sayohatim haqida aytib berayotgan edim...
cards.uzDef: Mavzuga qaytish yoki yangi mavzuni boshlash uchun ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: It was good seeing you, Sarah. Let's do this again soon.
cards.exUz: Sizni ko'rganimdan xursandman, Sarax. Buni tez orada yana qilaylik.
cards.uzDef: Uchrashuvdan keyin xursand bo'lganingizni bildirish.
